descends_from: T-I regime-intensity family (linear member), sixth-generation prior; hypothesis-ledger row 2026-07-20

rule.m_risk_ramp: 1.0 if warm-up or score <= 0.70; 0.35 if score >= 0.90; linear in between (floor 0.35)
rule.score_replay: ExpandingBtcRiskState from-origin causal replay over BTCUSDT daily context, one decision per day (liquidity_migration/continuous_btc_risk.py semantics)

scoring_recipe.surface: T-A render gate_off book (v4_shared.load_render_book), extended as renders refresh
scoring_recipe.row: one per completed UTC day after the registration boundary: entry-attributed completed-trade net under deployed weight vs r1 weight, hash-chained
scoring_recipe.boundary: first UTC midnight at/after this config's registration commit timestamp
scoring_recipe.metrics_frozen: ES95/ES99 of daily book net, max drawdown, native tail days (reference day net <= -1%), registered V2 tail set, net incl. costs+funding; MAR banned
scoring_recipe.slice_grades: G1/G2/G3 per docs/preregistration/untouched_slice_provenance_2026-07-20.md, one scripted read after this commit, opening recorded in INDEX.md

kill_criteria.R1-K1_premium_runaway: cumulative (r1 - deployed) shadow net <= -3% of book with >= 30 divergence days (|m_r1 - m_dep| >= 0.25) at a weekly check -> candidate killed
kill_criteria.R1-K2_tail_failure: at >= 60 forward days AND >= 10 native tail days: if r1 summed net on tail days is not better than deployed -> candidate killed
kill_criteria.R1-K3_insufficient_divergence: if < 20 divergence days after 120 forward days, extend once by 120 days; still short -> closed as insufficient-sample
kill_criteria.checked_by: weekly cadence alongside scripts/ops.sh kill-criteria (shadow-level; no runtime authority)

runtime_authority: none: shadow A/B only; any deployment needs a five-line promotion note + recorded change point + operator go
